history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

Source-hash rust 396938c8...; harness/borg.txt 31dda2eb..., otherwise as main before #543.

experiment.description: On borg-reborn-rs main 9ecbfd1e, does the ranged switch do better combined with the Phase Door switch or with the stairs switch? Generated from definitions/reborn-flee-combos-pilot.yaml: 4 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-main-9ecbfd1e, suite classes-18.
experiment.name: reborn-flee-combos-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-18: after the single-switch pilot (reborn-flee-switches-pilot, run 44212346856, where ranged alone had the fewest deaths), the owner asked for a pilot of all off, phase+ranged, stairs+ranged and all on.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-18, before any result was read (borg-zoo#235). Pilot (RULES 16); small and larger only after this
gate and the owner. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's three switch values in borg.txt and in
params-core.json of the death replays; no plan loaded; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped;
frozen-turn bursts classified and key outliers listed; death bundles reproduced; in ctl neither "# No Phase: no
monster next to me" nor "# No stairs: fighting at range on Scaryguy Level." appears. Consistency: ctl and all are
reborn-flee-switches-pilot's arms of the same names (same specimen and starts) and must replay its key hashes.
Report per arm and per class, from every game's messages: deaths and causes, final level, deepest level, paired
rescued and newly killed against ctl; Recall reads per game; the two #539 notes per game (the "# No Phase" note
also comes from the ranged switch, so it is not the Phase switch alone); ranged attacks within 3 keys of a
"# No stairs" note; scary-level deaths (a "Scary guy on level" note in the last 100 messages). Context: in the
single-switch pilot, ranged alone had 1 death against ctl's 3. 18 starts per arm show direction only.
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main 9ecbfd1e, does the ranged switch do better combined with the Phase Door switch or with the stairs switch?
